requirements.text: Full-time staff get 20 days of paid annual leave per calendar year.
requirements.quote: All full-time staff are entitled to 20 days of paid annual leave per calendar year.

requirements.text: Staff can carry over at most 5 unused annual leave days into the next year.
requirements.quote: Staff can carry over a maximum of 5 unused annual leave days into the next calendar year.

requirements.text: Staff can see their current leave balance in the app at any time.
